title: Joint Learning of Control Lyapunov Functions and Controllers via Stable-by-Design Surrogates
abstract: arXiv:2611.20900v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Training and verifying neural network-based control Lyapunov functions (CLFs) can be computationally demanding. To address this challenge, we propose a framework that jointly learns a CLF and a stabilizing controller using structured neural networks and a projection-based parameterization. Specifically, we employ Polyak-Lojasiewicz networks (PLNets), which parameterize nonconvex, positive-definite CLF candidates, and construct a stable-by-design surrogate of the closed-loop dynamics that satisfies the Lyapunov decrease condition by construction. The controller combines linear state feedback with a higher-order correction term resembling Sontag's universal formula and is trained to align the resulting closed-loop dynamics with the stable-by-design surrogate. translated_title: 基于按设计稳定的替代模型的控制李雅普诺夫函数与控制器联合学习
translated_abstract: 训练和验证基于神经网络的控制李雅普诺夫函数（CLF）在计算上可能非常耗时。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种利用结构化神经网络和基于投影的参数化方法来联合学习CLF和镇定控制器的框架。具体而言，我们采用Polyak-Lojasiewicz网络（PLNets）对非凸、正定的CLF候选函数进行参数化，并构建了闭环动力学的按设计稳定的替代模型，该模型在构造上即满足李雅普诺夫递减条件。所提出的控制器将线性状态反馈与类似于Sontag通用公式的高阶校正项相结合，并通过训练使得到的闭环动力学与该按设计稳定的替代模型保持一致。与基于Sontag公式的经典方法不同，我们的框架不需要已知的CLF，而是同时学习CLF和控制器。我们建立了局部和全局稳定性保证（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于PLNets结构化神经网络与按设计稳定的替代模型的新框架，能够同时联合学习控制李雅普诺夫函数和镇定控制器，无需预先已知CLF即可保证闭环系统稳定性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a framework that jointly learns control Lyapunov functions and stabilizing controllers using Polyak-Lojasiewicz networks and stable-by-design surrogates, guaranteeing closed-loop stability without requiring a pre-known CLF.
